site_name: 175 Lymington Avenue, Wood Green, London, N22 6JL
description:
Retention of a timber verandah structure to the rear of the property and hard landscaping within the front garden at 175 Lymington Avenue, London N22 6JL.

The application seeks retrospective permission for a modest verandah structure attached to the rear elevation of the dwelling. The structure provides covered outdoor amenity space for the occupants of the property.

Hard surfacing has also been installed within the front garden to improve access and provide off-street parking. The works remain ancillary to the residential use of the property.

The proposal does not involve any change of use and does not materially alter the character of the host dwelling.
